subject: 🏃 Friday — Stability & Power (Wk 6)
html:
Tomorrow evening: Stability & Power at Cañada College (housekeeper window, after 4:30 PM — last constrained session of the week, Sonia's back Saturday). Full Rx, single-leg and isometric work with PT block. Knee tracking is the focus.

Dynamic warm-up (5 min): foam roll quads/IT band 1 min each, 90/90 PAILs 30 sec each side, banded lateral walks 10 each direction, Spanish squat hold 30 sec, Copenhagen plank 20 sec each side.

Session — 3 sets × 8–10 reps per side (or timed):

  • Bulgarian split squat: 25 lb/hand, 3×10 — 3-sec eccentric, hips square. Cleared 25 lb/hand on May 22.
  • Single-leg RDL (contralateral): 25 lb single DB, 3×8–10 — stay contralateral (anti-rotation is the point), 3-sec eccentric, free hand reaches forward. No feel rating captured at 25 yet; hold load and get a clean read tonight.
  • Spanish squat hold: light band, 3×30–45 sec — vertical shin, deep knee bend.
  • Copenhagen plank: BW, 3×30 sec each side — top of prescribed range.

PT block (do this BEFORE the main lifts if time is tight — these are non-negotiable):

  • Side plank w/ hip abduction (top toe pointing to floor): 8 reps each side
  • Dead bug w/ banded pulldown: 2–3×10 slow marches
  • Chin tuck + lifts (front + diagonal): 2 reps each direction, 3-sec hold

Focus cue: get the PT block done. It's been dropped to time crunches on two of the last three Fridays (May 22 and the taper skip). These are the highest-leverage exercises for the medial PFJ diagnosis — do them first tonight so they don't get cut.

Context: Week 6 of 12, Phase 2 (Strength & Threshold). Presidio Half Marathon is 9 days out — the Pivot test that gates 3:30 → 3:25. Knee has been 1/5 for every V6 session except one mild 2/5 on Boston stairs (Jun 3). Sunday's 14-miler with 5 mi @ MP is the week's marquee session; tonight is about protecting that — single-leg stability and tendon resilience without fatiguing the quads. No data yet from Wednesday's heavy strength or Thursday's base run, so auto-regulate: if the legs are flat from back-to-back evening sessions, hold form over load. Lay out your gym bag tonight. Bed by 10 — the weekend schedule opens up with Sonia home.
